tasks.description: Move the left LEAP Hand to the specified neutral joint posture and hold it.
tasks.criterion_summary: Experimental full joint-vector error check; threshold is not physically calibrated.

tasks.description: Flex the index finger to the specified posture and hold it.
tasks.criterion_summary: Experimental index-finger joint-vector error check without an object scene.

tasks.description: Move the middle and ring fingers to matched specified postures and hold the symmetry.
tasks.criterion_summary: Experimental paired-joint symmetry check without an object scene.

tasks.description: Move the thumb to the specified opposition posture and hold it.
tasks.criterion_summary: Experimental thumb joint-vector error check; no grasped object is assumed.

tasks.description: Close the fingers through a bounded joint motion and finish in a minimal pre-grasp posture.
tasks.criterion_summary: Experimental final joint-posture check for a pre-grasp form; no object or contact claim.
